appointments_party_check.name: appointments_party_check
appointments_party_check.value: ("appointments"."customer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."guest_name" IS NULL AND "appointments"."guest_phone" IS NULL AND "appointments"."guest_email" IS NULL) OR ("appointments"."customer_user_id" IS NULL AND "appointments"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."guest_phone" IS NOT NULL)

opening_hours_times_check.name: opening_hours_times_check
opening_hours_times_check.value: ("opening_hours"."is_open" = false) OR ("opening_hours"."opening_time" IS NOT NULL AND "opening_hours"."closing_time" IS NOT NULL AND "opening_hours"."opening_time" < "opening_hours"."closing_time")

waiting_list_party_check.name: waiting_list_party_check
waiting_list_party_check.value: ("waiting_list_entries"."customer_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("waiting_list_entries"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL AND "waiting_list_entries"."guest_phone" IS NOT NULL)
